Why Attend KBGAS 2026?

Be at the forefront of aesthetic medicine's most significant global movement. This is your opportunity to master the techniques defining the future of the industry.

REGISTER NOW

Transform Your Practice with K-Beauty Innovation

The K-Beauty Global Aesthetic Summit offers unparalleled access to the world's most sought-after aesthetic protocols, delivered by internationally recognized experts in an intimate, hands-on environment.

1

Master the K-Beauty Mindset

Move beyond aggressive over-correction and learn the Korean philosophy of harmony, balance, and restraint. You will discover how to prioritize skin biology and preventive care to achieve subtle, refined results that enhance rather than mask natural beauty.

2

Unlock "Glass Skin" and "V-Line" Protocols

Gain immediate, practical knowledge on how to replicate the world-renowned Korean glow using current US-available products. You will learn specific micro-dosing strategies with neurotoxins and skin boosters to refine texture and tone.

3

Bridge the Gap Between East and West

See how to adapt cutting-edge Korean techniques to a Western patient base. This summit provides the evidence-based roadmap for integrating Eastern skin-driven approaches with Western structural rejuvenation.

4

Expert-Led Clinical Education

Learn directly from a curated faculty of international leaders, including world-renowned surgeons and top-tier injectable trainers. These sessions bridge theoretical concepts with clinical applications you can implement in your practice the following Monday.

5

Stay Ahead of Global Innovation

Be among the first to explore the next wave of aesthetic technology. From regenerative "cocktails" involving exosomes and PDRN to advanced energy-based device protocols, you will stay at the forefront of the rapidly evolving K-Beauty landscape.

6

High-Value Networking in Koreatown

Connect with an intimate, curated group of 100+ high-value practitioners and decision-makers. The summit provides a unique platform to forge meaningful professional relationships with like-minded clinicians and pioneering industry partners.

7

Earn While You Learn

Maximize your time with an intensive curriculum that offers up to 7 anticipated CME/CE hours. You will receive high-level medical education that fulfills professional requirements while elevating your clinical skill set.

8

Bring Seoul to Your Practice

There is no need to travel to Korea to learn the industry's best treatment algorithms for achieving K-Beauty standards. We bring authentic Korean innovation directly to North American practitioners, providing the same high-level insights and best practices found in the world's leading aesthetic clinics.

9

Understand the K-Beauty Influence

Learn why K-Beauty is the most esteemed and frequently copied aesthetic standard in the world. You will gain the knowledge and insight needed to bring these highly sought-after results to your own patients with clinical confidence.
